candidates.title: Dustin: Draft-Augmented Sparse Verification for Efficient Long-Context Generation with Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Targets KV-loading bottleneck in long-context speculative verification using draft lookahead plus historical target attention; ICML 2026 results report 27.85x attention and 9.17x end-to-end speedup at 32K.

candidates.title: SpecSA: Bridging Speculative Decoding and Sparse Attention for Efficient LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Co-designs speculative verification with dynamic sparse attention to increase cross-query KV reuse and reduce routing/kernel overhead; reports up to 3.49x end-to-end throughput.

candidates.title: Speculative Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Parallelizes the remaining draft/verify dependency by speculating likely verification outcomes and precomputing next drafts, a distinct serving-system concurrency direction.
